what: docs/21 viewer fixes, re-measured in the repo copy after landing them
how: Chromium against tools.serve on 127.0.0.1:8137, viewer/index.html with viewer/live-data.js (p0001) present. Every number below was computed in the page or from window.POSSESSION, not read off a screenshot.

defect_1_mirrored_short_axis.fix: ry() and its inverse ryi(); the `attacking` label; drawSpace cell height and anchor

check_can_fail.note: re-run against both transforms with an independently written projection that shares no code with the page

whole_roster_cross_check.note: before the fix this correlation was -0.9722

space_layer_alignment.note: the 1-yd Voronoi cell under each player's feet must carry that player's team colour, which fails if the layer is shifted by a cell or mirrored

radar_click_still_correct.note: ryi() had to be inverted with ry() or click-to-select would have gone mirrored. docs/21 did not mention it.

defect_2_matchup_lines_invisible.fix: dark halo under a near-white stroke, in literals; --dim/--bg/--warn reads on the overlay canvas all replaced
defect_2_matchup_lines_invisible.note: 2.4x the pixels, and 440 genuinely bright ones where the old --dim (#6b7364, L 70) produced none

defect_3_off_frame_feedback.fix: live count on the control, disabled at zero, plus a mark for slots with no position

control_reads.label: Off-frame 0
control_reads.title: Every slot with a position is inside this frame.

control_reads.label: Off-frame 0
control_reads.title: Every slot with a position is inside this frame.

lost_branch_exercised_deliberately.note: p0001 has ZERO slot-frames in the `lost` population - all 169 no-position frames are cold start, with no prior bearing to point at. The hollow-chevron branch therefore never fires on this possession and was tested by injecting a gap.
lost_branch_exercised_deliberately.method: null O5's position at an unvisited frame, then navigate there
lost_branch_exercised_deliberately.control_title: 2 outside the frame, 1 with no current position
lost_branch_exercised_deliberately.reason_roster_not_flagged: correct - the slot has a last bearing, so it gets a hollow chevron rather than a roster flag

hashchange.note: seek() writes the hash itself, so the listener no-ops when the hash already agrees with S.f

fresh_clone_path.method: live-data.js moved aside, loaded over a second origin to defeat the browser cache
fresh_clone_path.page_errors: none beyond the expected 404 on live-data.js
fresh_clone_path.note: the fixture's synthetic pinhole and the real homography agree on which way field y runs, which cross-validates the two projector backends

also.localStorage_read_guarded: viewer/index.html - the unguarded getItem docs/20 flagged sat at top level of the main script, so a browser blocking site data rendered the page blank
